action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Joshua Rogers discovered that Privoxy incorrectly handled memory
allocation, leading to a memory leak. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to cause Privoxy to consume excessive resources, leading to a denial
of service. (CVE-2021-44540)

Artem Ivanov discovered that Privoxy did not properly encode template names
in error pages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform
cross-site scripting attacks. (CVE-2021-44543)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Privoxy.
title: Privoxy vulnerabilities
